name: Fighter Devoted Defender
body:
A devoted defender is dedicated to protecting their charge, sometimes at the cost of their own safety.

Charge (Ex)

At 1st level, a devoted defender chooses a charge to be the focus of their defense once per day.

Once this choice is made it cannot be changed until the following day.

Bodyguard (Ex)

At 1st level, a devoted defender gains the Bodyguard and In Harm’s Way feats as bonus feats without needing to meet the prerequisites.

Additionally, they can grant aid another to their charge’s AC as a swift action.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feats gained at 1st and 2nd level.

Girded Mind (Ex)

At 2nd level, a devoted defender gains a +1 bonus on Will saves against compulsion spells and effects. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 devoted defender levels beyond 2nd.

This ability replaces all instances of bravery.

AC Bonus

At 4th level, a devoted defender gains a dodge bonus to AC when within 15 feet of their charge. Additionally, if adjacent to their charge, the charge gains the bonus as well. This bonus is equal to 1/4 the devoted defender’s class level.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feat gained at 4th level.

Defensive Strike (Ex)

At 5th level, a devoted defender may make an attack of opportunity against a creature that attacks their charge, assuming they are wielding a weapon for which they can make an attack of opportunity and within range of the attacker.

Additionally, the devoted defender gains a bonus to the attack and damage equal to 1/2 their class level.

This ability replaces all weapon trainings except 9th level, and replaces weapon mastery.

Defender’s Reflexes (Ex)

At 6th level, a devoted defender gains Combat Reflexes as a bonus feat, and they can use their Constitution modifier instead of their Dexterity modifier to determine the number of additional attacks of opportunity they can make per round. If they already have Combat Reflexes, they may choose a different bonus combat feat.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feat gained at 6th level.

Deflect Attack (Ex)

At 9th level, if a devoted defender is adjacent to their charge and the charge is attacked, they can expend an attack of opportunity to attempt to deflect the attack. They roll an attack roll and compare it to the attacker’s attack roll. If the attack roll is higher, the attack is deflected and it misses the target. A devoted defender takes a -2 penalty to this deflection attempt for every size category larger the target is than them. However, any penalties to attack from Combat Expertise and/or fighting defensively do not apply to this deflection attempt.

This ability replaces the weapon training at 9th level.
